change.summary: Keep a replayed H4 lease active when another current-generation occurrence is still Queued or Indeterminate.
change.bug_before: finalize_replayed_occurrence could append Released after one occurrence was reconciled, stranding a peer local outbox intent behind a terminal fence.
change.fix: Reuse the append-only outcome FSM in the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, excluding only the occurrence being finalized, and reject terminalization when any peer occurrence remains unresolved.
invariants: A queued replay still returns its original receipt without releasing the lease.
An indeterminate or terminal replay returns IllegalTransition when another current-generation occurrence is Queued or Indeterminate.
A rejected replay terminalization appends no lease row and preserves the exact active head and peer statuses.
After every peer occurrence is explicitly settled, replay finalization still appends one Released lease row with external_effect=false.
The guard is inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction as the terminal append, so a concurrent outcome transition cannot race the decision.
No provider target, external effect, KG write, promotion, or physical power-loss claim is introduced.

tests.note: Existing repository formatting drift and stable-tool configuration warnings remain; no formatter write was performed. The added hunks were manually checked against rustfmt output.

evidence.peer_unresolved_recovery: pass; indeterminate A plus queued B rejected replay release and left the active lease/head unchanged
evidence.production_writer_boundary: pass; ProductionDurableWriter::recover propagated the local IllegalTransition and did not terminalize the lease
evidence.settled_recovery: pass; explicit rollback of B then released A as released_indeterminate
evidence.transaction_scope: guard runs after full event/outbox pairing verification in the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction as append_lease

known_gaps: No physical power-loss or media-failure durability run has been executed.
No external signer, supervisor authority, provider-owned signed ACK/status, or production promotion is established.
The persistent qualification harness still lacks a store-wide pending-occurrence listing; this slice prevents premature lease closure but does not add enumeration.
Strict clippy and repository formatter baseline cleanup remain separate hygiene work.
receipt_sha256_basis: SHA-256 of this canonical receipt file is recorded in the companion SHA256SUMS file; self-hash is not embedded. This receipt carries local qualification evidence only and is not an authority grant.
